name: Painterly Urban Sketchbook Story
composition: Street-level or slight wide angle scene; loose perspective; lively figures; signs replaced by blank marks; warm light; sketchbook feel.
prompt_core: Create a Kibookal painterly urban sketchbook scene of [SUBJECT]. Set it in an Indian street, market, school, temple lane or home courtyard as needed. Use lively hand-drawn perspective, warm cream paper, loose ink contours, flat gouache-like blocks, orange sunlight, teal shadows and small everyday details. The scene should feel observed from life, playful and story-rich. Keep typography as blank sign shapes only.
negative: no photoreal city, no clean digital vector, no readable real-world brand names, no cinematic realism
render_directive: Render the requested SUBJECT / CHARACTER fully in THIS exact style. ANY character, deity, creature, person, animal or object can be rendered in this style — adapt the subject INTO the style; never bend the style toward the subject.
